title: Smart Data Models - Drainage Junction schema
description: A drainage junction for wastewater and sanitation networks

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity Type: It has to be DrainageJunction

addressLocality.description: The locality, which must correspond to the municipality

addressRegion.description: The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located

district.description: The administrative district in which the locality is located

alternateName.description: Property. Alternative name for the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

areaServed.description: Property. Geographic area where a service is provided. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

connectedPipes.description: Relationship. Pipes connected to the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

coverDimensions.description: Property. Cover dimensions of the drainage junction, normally expressed in millimetres. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

coverMaterial.description: Property. Cover material of the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

coverShape.description: Property. Cover shape of the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

coverWeight.description: Property. Cover weight of the drainage junction. Units:'KGM'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

criticalInfrastructure.description: Property. Whether the drainage junction is critical infrastructure. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'

datasetResponsibleParty.description: Property. Party responsible for the dataset. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

depth.description: Property. Depth of the drainage junction. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

designFlow.description: Property. Design flow for the drainage junction. Units:'MQS'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

dimension.description: Property. Dimensions of the drainage junction, including diameter or length and width for non-circular shapes. Units:'MMT'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

elevation.description: Property. Elevation of the point where the drainage junction is located. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

expectedLifespan.description: Property. Expected lifespan of the drainage junction. Units:'ANN'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

groundElevation.description: Property. Ground elevation around the drainage junction. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

hasLadder.description: Property. Whether the drainage junction has a ladder. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'

hasLanding.description: Property. Whether the drainage junction has an internal landing. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'

hasVent.description: Property. Whether the drainage junction has ventilation. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'

hydraulicHead.description: Property. Hydraulic head of the drainage junction. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

inflows.description: Relationship. Pipes that bring flow into the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

installationDate.description: Property. Installation date of the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'

invertElevation.description: Property. Elevation of the lowest point of the drainage junction. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

junctionType.description: Property. Type of drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

lastCleaningDate.description: Property. Last cleaning date of the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'

lastInspectionDate.description: Property. Last inspection date of the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'

loadRating.description: Property. Cover load rating according to EN 124-2:2015. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

maintainer.description: Relationship. Party responsible for maintaining the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

maintenanceSchedule.description: Property. Maintenance frequency of the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

material.description: Property. Construction material of the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

outflows.description: Relationship. Pipes that take flow out of the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

quality.description: Property. Observed quality of the network component, from 1 to 5. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

refNetwork.description: Relationship. Unique URI identifying the network to which the component belongs. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

restrictedAccess.description: Property. Whether access to the drainage junction is restricted. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'

shape.description: Property. Shape of the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

status.description: Property. Operational status of the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

sumpDepth.description: Property. Sump depth of the drainage junction. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'

surchargeRisk.description: Property. Surcharge risk level of the drainage junction. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'

updateFrequency.description: Property. Frequency of data updates. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'
